The present application is filed seeking interim bail for a period of one month in FIR No.201/2021 dated 28.07.2021, registered at Police Station Maidan Garhi for offences under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

5. List on 19.01.2026.
